textos.texto: Ana is Peruvian. She comes from Peru, a country in America. Lima is the capital of Peru, but Ana comes from a city with the name Arequipa. She lives in Canada. Canada is a country in America too, not in Europe. Ana speaks Spanish and English. She speaks French too, because in Canada French is a language too, and Quebec is French-speaking. Paul is Canadian. He was born in a city in Canada. Ana is a foreigner in Canada, but she speaks the language. Where are you from? I am from Peru, she says. And you? I am from here!

Good evening! Where are you from, Marc? I come from France. France is a country in Europe and my language is French. And you, Sofia? I am from Spain. My nationality is Spanish and I speak Spanish. Marie is from England. She speaks English, and she also speaks German. Is German a language in England? No! But Marie speaks it too. Ana is Peruvian. Her country is in America and she lives in Canada. The world is in this city, says Marc. And the United States? Paul was born in the United States, but he is Canadian. He lives in a Canadian city.

preguntas.enunciado: El alemán es un idioma de Inglaterra.
¿Qué idioma habla la amiga además de inglés?

textos.texto: Where are you from, Sofia? I come from Spain, from the capital. And you, Marc? I am from France, but I live in Canada. My city is in Quebec and Quebec is French-speaking. Is your nationality Canadian? No, my nationality is French. I am a foreigner here. Ana is Peruvian. She was born in a city in Peru and she comes from America. Her country is not in Europe. And you speak three languages? Yes: Spanish, English and French. The world has many countries! Where do you live, Sofia? I live in a city in England.

preguntas.enunciado: ¿En qué región de Canadá vive Marc?

textos.texto: I am Peruvian and I was born in Peru. My country is in America. I live in Canada, a country in America too. My city is not the capital. Do you speak English? Yes, and Spanish. I do not speak German. Is German a language in Europe? Yes! England, France and Spain are countries in Europe. The United States is in America. Are you a foreigner in Canada? Yes, I am a foreigner, but I speak the language and I live here. Marie comes from England. Her nationality is English and she speaks English and French.

Marie comes from England. Her country is in Europe and her nationality is English. She speaks English and French. Marc is from France, but he lives in Canada, in Quebec. Quebec is French-speaking. Sofia comes from Spain and she speaks Spanish. Ana is Peruvian: she was born in Peru, a country in America. She lives in Canada and she is a foreigner there, but she speaks the language. The capital of Peru is Lima, and Ana comes from a city with the name Arequipa. The United States is in America too. The world has many countries and many languages.
